text:
tess-docs: FYI I created a tiny PR to update the Console observability quickstart: the dashboard example uses an old field `trace_key` and the SDK snippets don't match latest `traceId`/`estimated_cost_usd` shape. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8420
rohan-eng: Thanks. Can you list which snippets are affected? I can patch the Go snippet and the dashboard label in one pass.
tess-docs: Affected: Node, Python, Go examples in /docs/console/observability/quickstart.md and the image caption that says "Cost by trace_key". Also a broken anchor to presets.
eli-ml: Note: runtime now returns `traceId` and `estimated_cost_usd` under telemetry.v1; older integrations may still send `trace_key`. We should add a 1-paragraph migration note.
sam-sdk: I'll update the SDK examples to read from `payload.traceId` and use `estimated_cost_usd`. Pushing a small testable snippet for Node + Go. Example: `tracehook.record({ traceId: payload.traceId, estimated_cost_usd: payload.estimated_cost_usd })`
mina-ux: UX suggestion: change panel title to "Cost by trace ID" (sentence case) and update screenshot alt text accordingly. Also make sure the caption includes the exact UI string.
link-bot: Link check: presets anchor URL is 404 -> needs canonical presets doc.
rohan-eng: Pushed dashboard label + alt text change. Also added migration blurb and replaced the broken anchor with the canonical presets link.
sam-sdk: SDK examples updated in PR branch. Kept Python snake_case, Go uses EstimatedCostUSD in struct example.
link-bot: CI link-check: all links OK now.
tess-docs: Merged. Leaving thread open for any follow-ups if SDK owners want to mirror in other guides. :thumbsup:
